gaps.detail: The broad no-passing-stopped-or-turning warning on physical one hundred twelve appears alongside the specific left-turning-vehicle right-pass exception on physical one hundred eleven. Hidden-hazard caution and the explicit exception are retained; no invented general reconciliation is scored.

Pupil-transport vans have warning equipment described differently from full-size school buses; no unprinted stop-arm equipment is inferred for vans. Work-zone fatality counts are withheld as contextual statistics. The animal section continues in the next mapped section.
